authorization: Référentiel IAO168 approuvé par Go intègre tout, demande actuelle de compléter IAO sans doublon, et conception DreamForge historique commun aux modes déjà définie.
acceptance: Exact duplicate authorized memory excerpts do not consume the unique text budget; no stored data mutation.
Conversation prepares an editable existing Workshop request bound to account and transfer identity; no implicit mission/model execution.
No stale storage or route-state leak across accounts; repeated same-page handoffs preserve existing editable input.
DreamForge undo/redo uses its existing shared history, context revisions and guards; archive replaced only with current version guard.
Existing tests retained, before/after regressions, fresh impact, typecheck/build and target CI before consolidation integration.
limits: No new auth authority, memory store, provider, paid service or production deployment.
Real canonical IAO runtime and ONE persistence require matching qualified ports; do not turn mere presence into ready.
